items.label: Config
items.content:
## AI Instance - Configuration ```javascript const client = new AIClient({ // Create new instance apiKey:'YOUR_API_KEY', // sk_... model:'openai', // AI model alias stream:true, // Stream response isImage:false, // Type you want seed:12345, // Seed for recreation chatId:'t1' // Chat ID (assemble chunks) systemPrompt("You are...") // AI System prompt }); ``` --- **apiKey**: (String) Your Pollinations.ai API key (starts with "sk_")
**model**: (String) The AI model you want to use. [View available models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/#:~:text=Models)
**Stream**: (Bool) Enable streaming. (view Text Generation > Stream) **isImage**: (Bool) Do you want to generate an image? => No (false)
**seed**: (Integer) Used to reproduce results.
**chatId**: (String/Number) Unique request ID used to assemble streamed chunks.
**systemPrompt()**: Instructions that the AI has to follow.

.generate()
items.content:
# Generate Text

```javascript
await client.generate('Write a short motivational quote about AI.');
```
- Uses streaming if enabled
- Seed ensures repeatable output

items.label: .destroy()
items.content:
# Cleanup Text Client

* **Automatic Cleanup:** The client automatically removes the `chatId` once a message has been generated or streamed. This helps prevent unnecessary memory usage and ensures that old chat sessions don’t linger.
* **Manual Cleanup:** You can manually terminate the client and free all associated resources by calling:

```js
client.destroy();
```

Use this if you want to completely reset the client or before shutting down your application to ensure no leftover sessions remain.

items.label: Init
items.content:
# Init Image Client

```javascript
const client = new AIClient({
  apiKey:'YOUR_API_KEY',
  model:'flux',
  isImage:true,
  width:1024,
  height:1024,
  seed:12345,
  chatId:'i1'
});
```
- `seed` ensures repeatable images
- `width` & `height` define size

items.content:
# Generate Image

```javascript
const blob = await client.generate('Futuristic city at sunset');
document.querySelector('#output-image').src = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
```
- Auto cleanup removes `chatId`
- Seed ensures reproducibility
